comment: Ruby block parameters, like `{ |key, value| }`. The builtin Ruby grammar scopes both `|` and the `,` between parameters as `punctuation.separator.variable.ruby`, so the theme can not highlight `|` as an operator (like Rust closures) without highlighting `,` too. This rule scopes the `,` as `punctuation.separator.object.ruby`, same as all other commas in Ruby.
